name: Piaggio P.180 Avanti
summary: Italian pusher twin turboprop with a three-surface layout: forward canard, mid-fuselage main wing and T-tail.

wings: Small forward wings (foreplanes) just behind the cockpit
Main wing is set far aft and mid-mounted, with the engines on its trailing edge
engines: Two PT6A turboprops facing backward (pushers) on the main wing
fuselage: Long, slender, pointed nose with a swept windshield
tail: T-tail with a tall swept fin
Twin ventral fins under the tail cone

tellTales: Small foreplane wings behind the cockpit and a big mid-set main wing
T-tail on a slender, pointed fuselage

confusedWith.howToTell: The King Air 350 has tractor props, a T-tail and no forward wing; the Avanti has pusher props, forward foreplanes and a rear-mounted main wing.
The King Air has props in front of its wings and no canards; the Avanti has pusher propellers at the rear of the wings and has small foreplanes.
